novelty_flags.label: Theorem da4-strict-extension
novelty_flags.one_line: The flagship strict-extension claim is against Proposition 4 alone; add a second named published recovery procedure and prove strict containment on a stated lm-graph class, rather than only on the bespoke front-door-lift family.

soundness_flags.label: def:causal-query, target_estimand, and estimand_functional
soundness_flags.one_line: The outcome alphabet is only declared finite, but tau multiplies by y and invokes E[Y]; declare a numerical outcome coding or restrict X_Y to a stated finite subset of R.

soundness_flags.label: def:response-polynomial-fiber and thm:tcf-soundness
soundness_flags.one_line: One unrestricted response-table weight per bidirected district does not in general encode the published semi-Markovian ADMG class: arbitrary joint district types can add latent dependence absent from a non-complete bidirected district, so Compat is not yet an exact presentation of Fiber.

soundness_flags.label: def:tcf-procedure and thm:colored-completeness
soundness_flags.one_line: TCF's definition already declares that a failed QE sentence returns a colored hedge and paired same-fiber models, so the headline completeness theorem largely unfolds its own output contract; make the algebraic-pair-to-colored-hedge compiler an independently specified construction and theorem.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Proceedings record, bibliographic entry and abstract
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The cited work is the 2025 UAI/PMLR paper introducing lm-SCMs, lm-graphs, FATE, and NATE.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2506.15441v1, corroborating preprint; proceedings PDF formula text was unavailable to fetch
source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 6-7, Figure 3(b) discussion and Proposition 4, equations (5)-(7)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper states Figure 3(b)'s fix-before-context recovery and Proposition 4's sufficient weighted NATE functional under conditions (i)-(v); it says a comprehensive solution would require integrating CSI calculus with missing-data recovery and need not be complete.

The paper assumes a positive distribution, and Theorem 5 says Algorithm 1 always terminates and any returned expression is correct; completeness is stated only for the no-label standard-do-calculus setting.
For maximal-regular labels with control variables that are observed roots, Theorem 1 reduces identification to every context DAG and Corollary 2 makes Algorithm 1 sound and complete.
Lemma 30 proves two simultaneously fixable CADMG vertices commute for graph and kernel; Theorem 31 supplies valid-sequence invariance under the nested Markov condition.
Proposition 1 identifies a missingness mechanism through a valid partial-order fixing schedule, including selected and latent subproblems, without claiming a general efficient schedule search.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2109.13471, corroborating preprint of the cited JASA article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Canonical response-function models polynomialize event probabilities, and the resulting polynomial program yields sharp bounds; this is a general semantic optimization framework, not an lm graphical hedge calculus.
The cited paper is a completeness result for full-law identification in graphical missing-data models, distinct from a query-specific NATE recovery target.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the district-table simplex by a response-function parameterization with independent latent factors respecting the individual bidirected-edge structure, then state and prove an exact equivalence between Compat and the published semi-Markovian lm-SCM fiber.

Move the colored-hedge extraction and positive paired-model compiler out of def:tcf-procedure; give its input, output invariants, and proof obligation as the substantive converse theorem rather than defining it into existence.

Add a second published comparator and a strict-containment theorem over a non-bespoke lm-graph class, for example jointly separating Proposition 4 and the root-control/context-by-context method on endogenous-indicator proxy graphs.
Declare an outcome score map X_Y to R, and use it consistently in the NATE functional so categorical outcomes remain supported without undefined arithmetic.

recommended_next_step: Revise the semantic fiber encoding and de-circularize the colored-hedge compiler before re-review; then add a two-comparator strict-containment result to restore a flagship path.
